meta.title: Manage Line Items: Save fails when Quantity is zero

plan.title: Manage Line Items Rejects Zero Quantity

steps.note: Open an existing saved draft event without inventing a title or ID.
Open the Manage Line Items window for the draft’s existing line item.
Enter the specified price so the validation is isolated to quantity.
Attempt to save the line item changes.

args.text: Please fill valid quantity on every line item

steps.note: Assert that Procol refuses the save with the documented quantity validation message.
